name: eventhub-platform
description: EventHub - Premium Full-Stack Event Management & RSVP Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
